text:
ellie: Heads up — I found a GCS object that looks like a daily config backup with several Vault-wrapped ciphertexts inside. Possibly from a partner webhook. Don't know blast radius yet.

tomas: Can you drop the object path? I'll pull audit logs.

ellie: gs://partner-uploads/daily-backups/2026-03-20.tar.gz

ellie: audit snippet:
```
protoPayload.methodName: "storage.objects.get"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "partner-ingest@partner-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
resourceName: "projects/_/buckets/partner-uploads/objects/daily-backups/2026-03-20.tar.gz"
```

mira (sec): ok — assume ciphertexts are KMS-wrapped/VAULT transit blobs. Immediate actions:
1) Revoke partner service account keys and rotate their SA if possible.
2) Rotate the KMS key used for wrapping (create new key version and rewrap).
3) Rewrap ciphertexts and replay into Vault (or re-upload re-encrypted artifacts).
4) Run a targeted secret rotation in Vault for any secrets referenced in that backup.

mira (sec): Commands to start (replace placeholders):
```
# disable SA key
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable <KEY_ID> --iam-account=partner-ingest@...

# create new KMS key version (or new key) and rewrap ciphertexts
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=<WRAP_KEY> --location=global --keyring=redwood-wrap

# rewrap (example using gcloud kms asymmetric decrypt/encrypt flow for wrapped blobs)
# or use vault transit rewrap if we wrapped via Vault transit
```

oncall-sre: Starting the rotation runbook now, tagging ops-oncall. Which Vault paths were in the backup? need exact paths to scope rotations.

ellie: I found these inside the tar:
- vault_kv_v2/partners/team-a/creds.json (multiple ciphertext blocks)
- vault_transit/keys/redwood-transit/metadata.json

mira (sec): Good — scope is partners/team-a and transit key metadata. Plan:
- Immediately revoke partner SA and disable ingestion pipeline (ops).
- Create new KMS wrapping key version and mark old version compromised.
- Rewrap all ciphertexts using new key, then rotate Vault KV secrets under partners/team-a.
- Rotate Vault transit key: create new transit key name redwood-transit-v2, re-encrypt values, and update policies.
- Add temporary RBAC deny on storage.objects.get for partner-ingest service account until partner-side rotation complete.

mira (sec): Also: enable storage audit sink to SIEM for partner bucket and add detection rule for any new object creation by that SA.

sec-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0321-GCS-CIPHERTEXT (link: https://incident.redwood.internal/INC-2026-0321-GCS-CIPHERTEXT)

tomas: I'm taking SA key revoke and KMS rekey steps. @oncall-sre can you handle Vault rewrap + KV rotations? I'll post exact commands when I have KMS key id.

oncall-sre: Yep, will run the Vault rewrap playbook (runbook:vault-rewrap-2025). ETA ~25m. Will capture logs and mark secrets rotated in the runbook checklist.

ellie: I'll contact the partner and ask for temporary ingestion pause. Also preparing an exported list of affected secret paths to share with infra.

mira (sec): Checklist (quick):
- [ ] partner SA disabled
- [ ] KMS wrapping key rotated
- [ ] ciphertexts rewrapped
- [ ] Vault KV secrets rotated (partners/team-a)
- [ ] transit key rotated and re-encrypted
- [ ] RBAC deny applied to partner SA on bucket
- [ ] audit sink + detection rule enabled
- [ ] partner notified and ingestion paused

tomas: Update: SA disabled, new KMS key version created (projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/redwood-wrap/cryptoKeys/partner-wrap/cryptoKeyVersions/3). Moving to rewrap step.

oncall-sre: Vault rewrap started, rotating partners/team-a paths. I'll ping when done.

ellie: thanks — will hold on partner notification until we confirm re-encrypt status. will schedule 30m window for coordinated rotation.

mira (sec): Good coordination. Once rewrap & rotation done, we'll run a quick vuln triage to see if anything else was present in that archive (no PII, etc.). Keep logs attached to the incident ticket.

tomas: LGTM. tagging @security-rotation for postmortem & retro.

oncall-sre: Done — KV rotations complete, transit re-encrypt finished. Added note to INC-2026-0321. All rotated values show healthy on read checks.

ellie: Notifying partner now and handing off next steps for audit retention and follow-up.

mira (sec): Great job. After partner confirms, schedule forced credential expiry for any long-lived tokens and run a broad search for similar artifacts in partner bucket prefixes.

sec-bot: Incident updated: status -> mitigated."
